name: Sauce Essentials Live Resin Disposable | Space Octane
description:
This sweet and fruity strain will have you in outer space in no time, with an uplift that’s coupled with relaxation. You’ll feel long term relief, but not comatose or couch locked. This strain has high potency and brings a burst of happiness. Space Octane is an excellent pain reliever and stress reducer.

Taste: Fruity, Candy, Citrus

Feels: Lifted, Happy, Relaxed

Strain: Space Cookies X RS11
